Hallway-left curved latch case, raised press pad, shorter right fixed cover and end cap observed. Door and hardware dimensions estimated.

record.notes: Hallway-facing Stairway 2 exit device (push bar), refined from four detail photos received 2026-10-29. Front view establishes the tall rounded latch case on hallway-view left, a broad press pad over roughly the left two-thirds of the horizontal rail, and a shorter fixed cover toward the right hinge end. Side views establish the curved projecting latch case, frame strike plate, backing rail, raised press pad, seam, small fixed-cover opening and compact right end cap. Replaces the earlier simplified full-width bar and block housings. Provisional dimensions: about 0.90 m overall width, 1.02 m center height and up to 0.11 m projection from the leaf; none tape-measured. No readable maker or model marking in these photos; manufacturer/model/part number and internal operation remain unknown. This is a visual reconstruction, not a functional or compliance assessment. Stairwell beyond remains unmodeled. Paper notices above the bar are now included with clear tape: a smoking/vaping NOTICE on view-left and PLEASE / DO NOT / SLAM DOOR on view-right, slightly lower. Readable notice body: SMOKING AND VAPING IS NOT PERMITTED WITHIN 25 FEET OF ALL ENTRANCES. Four prohibition symbols are simplified; their tiny pictograms are unresolved. Context frames show a solid door leaf, an upper closer and a transom above the header; the earlier invented leaf window has been corrected. Notice dimensions, placement and closer/transom sizes remain estimated.
record.evidenceNote: Four user-supplied detail photographs, plus video 00:54 and 00:18 for context. Receipt/review date 2026-10-29 is not a verified capture date. Earlier evidence retained; new dimensions are photo-derived estimates.
